senses.gloss: (= קשקש; cmp. כַּרְכֵּשׁ II) to knock, clap, ring.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:17">Tosef. Sabb. XIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:17">XIV</cite>), 17 <he>אין מְקַרְקְשִׁין לא וכ׳</he> you must not ring a bell or a clapper for a child &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12:9">Gen. R. s. 12</cite> <he>מְקַרְקֶשֶׁת בקרניה</he> she knocks with her horns (against the rocks); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 862:13">Yalk. Ps. 862</cite> <he>מְקַשְׁקֶשֶׁת</he>; (Midr. Sam. ch. IX <he>מַקֶּשֶׁת</he>, v. <cite ref="N01251"><he>נָקַשׁ</he></cite>).
